github._note: Official remote GitHub MCP server - OAuth via /mcp in an interactive claude session. No PAT stored anywhere. Replaces the deprecated @modelcontextprotocol/server-github package.

postgres._note: .env holds DATABASE_URI=... (UTF-8, NO BOM - docker --env-file cannot parse a BOM). Use a read-only DB role + restricted mode = two-layer write block. Replaces the archived @modelcontextprotocol/server-postgres (unpatched SQL injection).
